category_title: Gifted Hispanic female underachieving due to perceived inadequacy and lack of task relevance
scenario_title: FCAT reading assessment preparation and perceived inadequacy
minimal_context: The student and tutor are working one-on-one in English class to prepare for the FCAT reading assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's work on preparing for the FCAT reading assessment. Please read this passage and answer the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to use test-taking strategies to defeat this assessment instead of actually reading it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you try using the insight and divergent thinking you use in your writing assignments?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't think of that as a strategy for this. The FCAT is just about analysis and test-taking strategies, not finesse.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best on the reading assessment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to stop trying so hard. Failing this makes me feel like an 'inadequate student' and failure is inevitable anyway. I don't want to define myself as the 'intellectual type'.
